summary_en: Peers will cancel 685,600 shares on November 20, 2026, representing 6.73% of issued shares before cancellation.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Peers Co., Ltd. resolved on November 12, 2026 to cancel 685,600 treasury shares, effective November 20, 2026. The cancellation represents 6.73% of issued shares before the cancellation. As of September 30, 2026, issued shares after cancellation will total 9,500,000, with treasury stock of 495,557 shares remaining.
